cards.name: Soundwave, Sonic Spy // Soundwave, Superior Captain

question: Another card tells me to transform a Soundwave, Sonic Spy. Because Soundwave converts instead, does that effect convert it?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: an instruction to transform one of these cards makes you convert it.
expected.answer: Similarly, an ability of another card that instructs you to "transform" one of these cards will cause you to convert it, even if that ability doesn't use the word "convert."
